<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_box">
  <api>
    <prop name="x" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_box" required="true" help="Left edge" />
    <prop name="y" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_box" required="true" help="Top edge" />
    <prop name="width" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_box" required="true" help="Length in pixels" />
    <prop name="height" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_box" required="true" help="Height in pixels" />
    <prop name="filled" type="bool" draw="u8g2gl_draw_box" default="true" help="Whether box is filled or outline frame" />
    <prop name="radius" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_box" default="0" help="Corner radius in pixels" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_button" extends="u8g2gl_obj">
  <api>
    <prop name="text" type="string" setter="set_text" default=""
          help="Button label text string." />
    <prop name="font" type="font" setter="set_font" required="true"
          help="U8G2 font for button text." />
    <prop name="border_width" type="int" setter="set_border_width" default="1"
          help="Border stroke thickness in pixels." />
    <bind name="bind_text" type="string" setter="bind_text"
          fmt="bind_text_fmt" />
    <bind name="bind_text_int" type="int" setter="bind_text"
          fmt="bind_text_fmt" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_circle">
  <api>
    <prop name="x" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_circle" required="true" help="Center X coordinate" />
    <prop name="y" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_circle" required="true" help="Center Y coordinate" />
    <prop name="radius" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_circle" required="true" help="Circle radius in pixels" />
    <prop name="filled" type="bool" draw="u8g2gl_draw_circle" default="false" help="Whether circle is filled disc" />
    <prop name="segments" type="enum" draw="u8g2gl_draw_circle" values="all,upper_left,upper_right,lower_left,lower_right" default="all" help="Circle segments to draw" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_clock" extends="u8g2gl_obj">
  <api>
    <prop name="time" type="int" setter="set_time" default="0"
          help="Initial epoch time in seconds." />
    <prop name="format" type="enum" setter="set_format"
          values="hh_mm,hh_mm_ss" default="hh_mm"
          emit="U8G2GL_CLOCK_{VALUE^^}"
          help="Clock display format: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS." />
    <prop name="font" type="font" setter="set_font" required="true"
          help="Primary U8G2 font for hours and minutes." />
    <prop name="secondary_font" type="font" setter="set_secondary_font"
          help="Secondary U8G2 font for seconds digits." />
    <prop name="blink" type="bool" setter="set_blink" default="true"
          help="Enable 1Hz colon blink animation." />
    <bind name="bind_time" type="time" setter="bind_time" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_ellipse">
  <api>
    <prop name="x" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_ellipse" required="true" help="Center X coordinate" />
    <prop name="y" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_ellipse" required="true" help="Center Y coordinate" />
    <prop name="rx" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_ellipse" required="true" help="Horizontal radius in pixels" />
    <prop name="ry" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_ellipse" required="true" help="Vertical radius in pixels" />
    <prop name="filled" type="bool" draw="u8g2gl_draw_ellipse" default="false" help="Whether ellipse is filled" />
    <prop name="segments" type="enum" draw="u8g2gl_draw_ellipse" values="all,upper_left,upper_right,lower_left,lower_right" default="all" help="Ellipse segments to draw" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_glyph" extends="u8g2gl_obj">
  <api>
    <prop name="glyph" type="int" setter="set_glyph" required="true"
          help="16-bit glyph codepoint from font table." />
    <prop name="font" type="font" setter="set_font" required="true"
          help="U8G2 font containing the glyph." />

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_hline">
  <api>
    <prop name="x" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_hline" required="true" help="Left edge" />
    <prop name="y" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_hline" required="true" help="Top edge" />
    <prop name="width" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_hline" required="true" help="Length in pixels" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_label" extends="u8g2gl_obj">
  <api>
    <prop name="text" type="string" setter="set_text" default=""
          help="Static display text. Overridden when bind_text is active." />
    <prop name="font" type="font" setter="set_font" required="true"
          help="U8G2 font for rendering." />
    <prop name="align" type="enum" setter="set_align"
          values="left,center,right" default="left"
          emit="U8G2GL_ALIGN_{VALUE^^}"
          help="Horizontal text alignment within bounds." />
    <prop name="long_mode" type="enum" setter="set_long_mode"
          values="clip,dots,scroll,scroll_circular" default="clip"
          emit="U8G2GL_LONG_{VALUE^^}"
          help="Overflow behaviour when text exceeds the widget width ([D-19]).
                clip hard-clips at the bounds; dots truncates with an
                ellipsis; scroll and scroll_circular marquee the text.
                wrap is not offered — U8G2GL labels are single-line, so a
                user arriving from LVGL Pro will meet this omission
                deliberately rather than find it missing silently." />
    <prop name="scroll_px_per_sec" type="int" setter="set_scroll_px_per_sec" default="25"
          help="Marquee scroll speed in pixels per second. Meaningless unless
                long_mode is scroll or scroll_circular." />
    <prop name="initial_delay_ms" type="int" setter="set_initial_delay_ms" default="3000"
          help="Initial pause delay in milliseconds before scrolling starts.
                Meaningless unless long_mode is scroll or scroll_circular." />
    <prop name="static_dwell_ms" type="int" setter="set_static_dwell_ms" default="5000"
          help="Dwell duration in milliseconds for text that fits within
                bounds before signalling completion. Meaningless unless
                long_mode is scroll or scroll_circular." />
    <bind name="bind_text" type="string" setter="bind_text"
          fmt="bind_text_fmt" />
    <bind name="bind_text_int" type="int" setter="bind_text"
          fmt="bind_text_fmt" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_line">
  <api>
    <prop name="x1" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_line" required="true" help="Start X coordinate" />
    <prop name="y1" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_line" required="true" help="Start Y coordinate" />
    <prop name="x2" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_line" required="true" help="End X coordinate" />
    <prop name="y2" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_line" required="true" help="End Y coordinate" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_obj">
  <api>
    <prop name="x" type="int" setter="set_coords" help="Left edge in device pixels." />
    <prop name="y" type="int" setter="set_coords" help="Top edge in device pixels." />
    <prop name="width" type="int" setter="set_coords" help="Width in device pixels." />
    <prop name="height" type="int" setter="set_coords" help="Height in device pixels." />
    <prop name="hidden" type="bool" setter="set_hidden" default="false" help="Exclude from rendering." />
    <prop name="disabled" type="bool" setter="set_disabled" default="false" help="Disable object interaction." />
    <prop name="font" type="font" setter="set_font" help="Resolved U8G2 font." />
    <prop name="draw_color" type="color" setter="set_draw_color" default="1" help="Monochrome draw color (0, 1, xor)." />
    <prop name="invert" type="bool" setter="set_invert" default="false" help="Invert foreground and background." />
    <prop name="padding" type="int" setter="set_padding" default="0" help="Inner padding in pixels." />
    <prop name="border" type="bool" setter="set_border" default="false" help="Render outer border." />
    <prop name="radius" type="int" setter="set_radius" default="0" help="Corner rounding radius in pixels." />
    <prop name="align" type="enum" setter="set_align" values="left,center,right" default="left" emit="U8G2GL_ALIGN_{VALUE^^}" help="Horizontal text alignment." />
    <bind name="bind_text" type="string" setter="bind_text" fmt="bind_text_fmt" />
    <bind name="bind_text_int" type="int" setter="bind_text" fmt="bind_text_fmt" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_pixel">
  <api>
    <prop name="x" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_pixel" required="true" help="Pixel X coordinate" />
    <prop name="y" type="int" draw="u8g2gl_draw_pixel" required="true" help="Pixel Y coordinate" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_progress_bar" extends="u8g2gl_obj">
  <api>
    <prop name="value" type="int" setter="set_value" default="0"
          help="Target progress percentage (0..100)." />
    <prop name="fill_style" type="enum" setter="set_fill_style"
          values="solid,stipple" default="stipple"
          emit="U8G2GL_FILL_{VALUE^^}"
          help="Fill pattern for progress bar (solid or 2x2 checkered stipple)." />
    <prop name="animate_duration_ms" type="int" setter="set_animate_duration_ms" default="0"
          help="Animation duration in milliseconds for value transitions (0 = instant)." />
    <prop name="show_percent_text" type="bool" setter="set_show_percent_text" default="false"
          help="Render numeric percentage text centered in progress bar." />
    <prop name="font" type="font" setter="set_font"
          help="Font used for centered percentage text." />
    <bind name="bind_value" type="int" setter="bind_value" />
  </api>
</widget>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<widget name="u8g2gl_switch" extends="u8g2gl_obj">
  <api>
    <prop name="value" type="bool" setter="set_value" default="false"
          help="Initial switch toggle state (true = ON, false = OFF)." />
    <bind name="bind_value" type="bool" setter="bind_value" />

</widget>
